text:

name: Juliet Tyler
text: Excellent service from the initial consultation about air conditioning to the fitting and aftersales. So good my mother has now had a unit fitted and a lot of interest from friends and family.

name: Martin Ventham
text:
We had air conditioning fitted to two rooms and couldn’t be happier with Dan and his team.. Communication was excellent from start to finish. It was a tricky install, but Dan’s knowledge and experience meant he made light work of it. We had a minor issue that was beyond his control, but he still returned promptly the same day to resolve it. He worked neatly throughout, leaving everything clean and tidy, and made good to the walls exactly as agreed. The units are high quality and working perfectly, it has been a complete game changer the last last couple of weeks. We would highly recommend his services.
Thanks again 👍

name: Karen Stacey
text: Absolutely fantastic service from start to finish. The team were professional, friendly, and efficient throughout the installation. They arrived on time, explained everything clearly, and left everything clean and tidy when they finished. The air conditioning works perfectly, and the difference it has made is amazing. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for a reliable, high-quality installation. Thank you for such an excellent job!

name: rich rudy
text:
10/10 service 11/10 efficiency. Arrived on said date and finished on said date. Cleanliness & manners next to none - made the whole install process smooth & no waste laying around ( I'm a clean freak) thanks Danny and the team
Highly recommend

name: Charlie Perrin
text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I honestly can’t recommend Number One Air Conditioning enough.

From the first time I got in touch they replied really quickly and made the whole process so easy.

Danny did the installation and he was brilliant. Really friendly, professional and took the time to explain everything. The quality of his work was spot on and you can tell he really takes pride in what he does.

Before getting air conditioning the heat in the house was horrible. Sleeping at night was a nightmare and trying to relax or get any work done on hot days just wasn’t enjoyable. I kept putting it off thinking I could manage without it but I wish I’d done it years ago.

Now the house stays nice and cool and it’s honestly made such a big difference. I’m sleeping better, the house is so much more comfortable and it’s probably one of the best investments I’ve made.

If you’re thinking about getting air conditioning just do it. And if you’re looking for a company you can trust then definitely give Number One Air Conditioning a call.

Great service from start to finish and Danny was excellent.

Couldn’t be happier with it - cheers guys.

name: Keri Cross
text: We kept saying we needed air con and finally got it done, we couldn’t be happier! They were all so lovely and left everything really tidy!

name: Lewis Lindsay
text: Great service from start to finish. Turned up when they said they would, clean install, no messing about, and the aircon works spot on. Office is already a much better place to work in this heat. Would happily recommend.
